_readme: LIVING registry — the biome's organisms as DNA-promoted specimens. Not scenes: each entry is a grammar token rendered by a morphology, so its axes are derived from the biome grammar + the preset families on disk (tools/promote_living_dna.py), not from @export vars. Swept and judged by the same DNA loop as the artifacts.

living_fungus_fruit.name: living_fungus_fruit
living_fungus_fruit.description: the fruiting mushroom — FungusMorphology cap+stem+gills from a curated preset

dna.derived_from: fungus_presets/ families on disk + the t= ladder
dna.note: family is the mushroom's SPECIES (five curated bodies, 12 variants each); tier is how big it stands. The axis the loop should bite on is family.

living_fungus_pose.name: living_fungus_pose
living_fungus_pose.description: the same mushroom under a soft-body pose (static, no physics)

dna.note: pose is what GRAVITY did to it — droop, bloat, squash, wilt, lean. A settled thing lies flat and level.

living_fungus_colony.name: living_fungus_colony
living_fungus_colony.description: the fungus colony substrates — computed (CA voxel network) vs grown (mycelium filaments)

dna.note: the kingdom's argument: the same organism as a CA that is visibly COMPUTED, filaments visibly GROWN, a fruiting body, a posed body, or one continuous SDF skin.

living_flora_tree.name: living_flora_tree
living_flora_tree.description: the tree — L-system tubes vs one continuous SDF trunk

dna.note: lsystem grows a branching grammar; sdf welds the same skeleton into one skin. Two ontologies of the same tree.

living_flora_bloom.name: living_flora_bloom
living_flora_bloom.description: the botanical flower — species by tier

dna.note: the tier ladder is really a SPECIES ladder here (bluebell -> orchid -> daisy); the gallery's flower strip found that. Whether tier should mean bigger or other is a ruling, not a default.

living_fauna_body.name: living_fauna_body
living_fauna_body.description: the creature — a continuous SDF grub, spine+head+legs smooth-unioned

dna.note: position seeds the DNA, so every cell grows a different individual; tier is the only declared axis, and the loop should test whether it bites.

living_ground_role.name: living_ground_role
living_ground_role.description: what a declared cell DOES — the grammar's role vocabulary

dna.note: seed grows now; field waits to be claimed; halo spills wilderness past the rim; mute is the declared vacuum. The role is the cell's verb.
